name: Living Healthy
overview: Scripture teaches that living healthy encompasses both physical nourishment and spiritual well-being. From the provision of God-given foods in Genesis 1:29 to the healing and peace promised in Jeremiah 33:6, God’s care extends to our bodies and souls. A joyful heart benefits health as Proverbs 17:22 illustrates, while true satisfaction comes through Christ, the bread of life (John 6:35). Additionally, living healthy involves fearing the Lord, turning from evil (Proverbs 3:7), and renewing the mind to discern God’s perfect will (Romans 12:2).
